about: Judge Mode samples (D-153, D-164). CC0 photos of public places from Wikimedia Commons (credits in SOURCES.md): two in Ljubljana (judge-01, judge-03) and one in Berlin-Lichtenrade (judge-02), with solid masks over people, adverts showing people and real number plates, and a drawn prop (a name-tag lunchbox on judge-03). The pass-B answers are LIVE recordings of the cloud attacker (gemini-3.5-flash-lite, Nov 23 2026; D-161, D-164), the first answer per sample, replayed only when the live attacker is unavailable. judge-03 had nothing removable to fix, so no re-attack was recorded and its 'fixed' file repeats the first answer. Each sample's fake-vault pins are public places near it (a park and a square): the manifest's pins for the Ljubljana samples, judge-02's own pins for Berlin (D-164).
